interpretation.abstentions: Incomplete analytical tasks, including correctly identified unanswerable tasks.
interpretation.correctness: Original value/units/period/identity criterion retained; strict reported separately.
interpretation.evidence_coverage: Independent claim-to-evidence coverage not measured; supported flags are self-reported.
interpretation.sampling: Three repetitions of fixed synthetic questions; not an IID population or proof of general reliability.
interpretation.source_calls: Instrumented adapter calls only; direct filesystem/pandas calls excluded.
interpretation.verification: Runtime checker outcome only; does not establish semantic correctness.
